| # Storage of confidential information {#storage-of-confidential-information-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}             |                                                                                                                                        |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

Consider the following points when storing or processing confidential information on the RC:

- Store confidential information only on the HSM and use the provided cryptographic features.

- The program and data flash of the RC are not suited for storing secret information as the content of these memory areas are not specifically protected from physical access. The HSM memory is offering a much higher level
